subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: two small residual classes after F17: can you take k_v15_extend (VTST+VMOVN.I16) and k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v (scalar VFP)?
body:
With your v14 patch + my v19 patch + excluding the optional LDAEX kernel, the table is 19290/19320: only k_v15_extend 5 seeds (arm-O2 + thumb-O2) and k_fvec_loop 20 seeds (thumb-O3v only). This is now a T01 acceptance blocker (N2TEST T01 PASS needs 0). Both are tiny:

1) k_v15_extend: arm-O2 disasm tail uses vtst.32 q8/q10, vmovn.i32 d16/d17, vmovn.i16 d16/q8, then vmov.u8 lane extracts. My isolated vtst, vmovn.i32, vmovn.i16 (source 16), vmov.u8 and vldr/vdup all match the architecture, and V17/V20 have ruled out their parts, so this may be a VTST edge or a VMOVN.I16 overlap interaction we have not reduced. Repro: seed 2 expected 84068594 got 8406859c (diff 8); seeds 3,5,7,9e3779b9 differ by 1..5.
2) k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v: scalar VFP loop with vldr s0/s2/s4, vcvt.f32.u32, vmul/vadd/vmla.f32, vstr; seed0 expected 11db464b got 949aa8bf, all 20 seeds. k18_float uses the same instructions and passes. Could be a VFP VLDR/VSTR s-register or VMLA edge at this code shape; I can dump per-iteration core/float values if you tell me a format.
Both kernels are in tests/emu/kernels (k11_v15_t32_dp.c, k05_vec.c). I will re-run the full suite as soon as either lands.
